title: Fix bugs in a Go math utility module
description: Brownfield Go dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in math utility functions (Factorial, GCD, IsPrime). The repo_seed has broken code; the agent must fix all bugs so tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in mathutil.go.

Bug 1 — Factorial: base case should return 1 for n==0 (not 0).
  Fix: change `if n <= 0 { return 0 }` to `if n <= 0 { return 1 }`

Bug 2 — GCD: remove the wrong check `if a == 0 { return 0 }` after the loop.
  The Euclidean algorithm already handles GCD(0, b) == b correctly via the loop.
  Simply return a after the loop.

Bug 3 — IsPrime: the divisibility check condition is inverted.
  Fix: change `if n%i != 0` to `if n%i == 0`

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: IsPrime(7) returns true, IsPrime(9) returns false
IsPrime(2) returns true, IsPrime(4) returns false
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
